content:
Had the privilege of attending an enriching seminar on Intellectual Property Rights, organized by the Faculty of Legal Studies, Usha Martin University. 
We were honored to have Mr. Abhinav Gupta, esteemed professor from NUSRL shares his invaluable insights on the evolving landscape of IPR laws and their real-world significance.
The session offered a wonderful blend of academic depth and practical understanding, leaving all of us with fresh perspectives on the subject. Grateful for such enriching learning opportunities that go beyond the classroom!
